newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING DEBT MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch bonds digested mixed U.S. producer price data to finish lower as investors continued to switch into higher-yielding Dutch corporate paper.
Dealers said news that the October producer price index (PPI) rose more than expected but that core PPI fell had little impact.
They said the focus now turned to the Federal Open Market Committee meeting, now underway, and October consumer price data on Thursday for signs on the direction of U.S. interest rates.
A trader said that with Dutch rates near 1996 lows, nobody was prepared to take new positions in state loans.
